scope: Local JavaScript source-level contract checks using a minimal DOM stub. No browser layout, browser interaction, native Paper or production acceptance is claimed.

checks.name: All 29 distinct page/view combinations render without undefined or non-finite values
All 48 primary data-state combinations render and retain navigation
FX inverse arithmetic and chart path use reciprocal values
Small FX quotes retain five-decimal axis precision
Delayed CHF cells cannot leak current values or magnitude color
Crypto source failure withholds the leverage aggregate
Bitcoin replay changes the model and all driver states with history
A valid zero target remains zero rather than unavailable
Performance brush changes narrative, drawdown and matching ledger context
Selected decision opens its own original identity and vintage
Reserves keep country-specific events, capacity and coverage
Bond sensitivity computes a 50 bp shock on the separate sample exposure
URL reload preserves comparison, scenario and source context
Research drafts survive a context change and retain units/source identity
Narrow chart geometry recomposes rather than shrinking 820-unit text
Untrusted view URLs cannot inject asset markup or break evidence rendering
